scope: Production Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M pp512 Q4 and Q6 selected-down consumers on gfx1151

hardware.performance_level_qualification: The root-owned sysfs performance-level control is not writable by the benchmark user. No locked-clock claim is made.

protocol.command_template: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --pmc <FETCH_SIZE|MemUnitBusy> --kernel-include-regex '.*gguf_q[46]_k_t16_selected.*' --output-directory <TMP> --output-file down_<COUNTER> -f csv -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --lengths 512,1024,4096 --chunk-size 2048 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output <TMP>/child.json
protocol.counter_collection: One hardware-compatible counter group per process
protocol.pp512_selection: The second contiguous grid-size group after the M128 warmup: Q4 grid 1,253,376 threads / 24 calls; Q6 grid 2,039,808 threads / 23 calls

q4_down.interpretation: Q4 down is controller-bandwidth-bound and its physical fetch closely tracks the scheduled row-tile weight request. The remaining local arithmetic/LDS ceiling is small; eliminating the 1.378x row-tile reread is the only material exact in-family lever.

q6_down.interpretation: Q6 down is not saturating the controller, has only a 1.113x route-tile reread factor, and is not LDS- or occupancy-limited. Its remaining cost includes Q6 decode/instruction latency; larger row geometry and K staging are already rejected.

combined.qualification: The perfect-removal row is an Amdahl bound, not a performance claim. It assumes all scheduled duplicate weight requests disappear at current per-family bandwidth with no replacement cost.

decision.next: Screen a down-specific expert-persistent K256 slab that exploits K1024 and one projection: four partial passes, approximately one quarter of the rejected K3072 dual gate/up persistent state. Reject before integration unless it is exact and positive on actual Q4 layers.
closed: more Q4 local arithmetic/LDS tuning without byte reduction
more Q6 row-width or K-staging sweeps
